features.title: Everything you need for Natural Science

tutor.title: AI tutor
tutor.description: Ask by typing, speaking or sending a photo of an exercise. Answers follow the official textbook and your teachers' materials.

practice.title: Smart practice
practice.description: Multiple-choice quizzes, AI-graded essays, flashcards and mind maps for every topic.

arena.title: Knowledge arena
arena.description: Challenge classmates or play against the AI in real time, with feedback after every match.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.description: Earn XP, keep your study streak, complete challenges and climb the weekly leaderboard.

teachers.title: Tools for teachers
teachers.subtitle: Manage classes and practice content, and follow each student's learning.

knowledge.title: Feed the AI tutor your materials
knowledge.description: Upload PDF or Word files: the tutor answers from them and suggests questions for you to review.

classes.title: Students and classes
classes.description: Import student lists from Excel, issue accounts, assign classes and manage the question bank.

reports.title: Learning reports
reports.description: See study hours, questions asked, practice and arena results for every student.

learn.title: Sign in and learn

grow.title: Improve every day
